mines.mine_notes: Operated by PT J Resources Bolaang Mongondow (JRBM), effective ownership 99.99% (AR 2023 subsidiary list). Open-pit mine, heap leach gold processing, North Sulawesi; holds 6th Generation Contract of Work (38,150 Ha, Bakan and Lanut blocks) valid until 2034. Gold sold as dore bullion. 9M2024 production 71,883 oz.

Operated by J Resources Gold (UK) Limited (JRGL), effective ownership 99.99% (AR 2023 subsidiary list). Open-pit mine in Pahang State, peninsular Malaysia (central gold belt); group of mining licenses and mining concessions covering 1,221.83 Ha. Uses resin-in-leach processing. 9M2024 production 5,585 oz.
Owned via PT Sago Prima Pratama (SPP), holds Mining Business License - Production Operation (IUP-OP) covering 3,560 Ha in North Kalimantan. In post-mining stage.
Part of JRBM's Contract of Work; ceased operations at end of 2015, entered post-mining stage in 2020 with focus on rehabilitation and sustainable closure.
New mine under development, located in North Sulawesi. No production yet.
